_comment: Merged config for /seo. Written once by references/foundation.md §1 and never overwritten. Real configs drift from this template — add keys where they fit the file you found, never reshape an existing config to match this shape. null means 'not detected yet, fill on first need'.

site.name: Sigge
site._comment_aliases: Brand name variants an answer engine or a mention search might use, including the misspelling you keep seeing.

locale._note: Ägaren jobbar internationellt; svenska och engelska väger båda.

site._comment_sitemap_url: The live sitemap (or sitemap index) URL. scripts/health_diff.py --sitemap reads this every run; stack.sitemap_path is the file that generates it.
site._comment_brand_regex: Optional override for the branded-query split (scripts/brand_split.py). When null the script builds one from site.name and site.aliases.
site._comment_brand_regex_sigge: Sigge är också ett vanligt smeknamn, så bara "sigge" ihop med copy/MCP/AI/skriv, eller domänen, räknas som varumärke.

stack._comment_marketing_controller: Controller-based stacks only (Rails/Django/Laravel). File-routed stacks leave this null.
stack._comment_content_store: Resolved by references/content-stores.md, which replaces this string with its object form (type, platform, base_url, read_method, write_method, model_or_collection, body_format, auth_note) once detected. For app_db stores, references/stacks/app-db.md adds the table, field, status, revision and preview fields the fix and programmatic lanes need.

figure_style._comment: Auto-detected visual recon (references/visuals.md). Never interview the user about this.
figure_style.notes: Fraunces + Inter, självhostade. Varm off-white #f7f4ee, bläckblå.

stack._comment_kind: Express (app.ts) på Vercel. Statiska sidor byggs av scripts/build-pages.mjs från client/pages/*.html + client/messages.js; person- och ramverkssidor från data/ via scripts/seo-pages.mjs.

gsc._comment: The EXACT property string from list_properties. 'sc-domain:example.com' and 'https://example.com/' are not interchangeable. null means the site is not verified in this Google account — say it once and carry on.

bing._comment: Optional. api_key_env names the environment variable holding the Bing Webmaster API key; never store the key itself. The AI Performance report is UI-only — no API. Record Bing as a separate panel, never summed with Google.
bing._comment_env_source: Nyckeln finns i Projekt/.env.shared, inte i repot.

competitors.name: Copy.ai
competitors.why: AI-skrivverktyg som skriver texten åt dig; Sigge ger din egen AI ramverk i stället

_comment_content_surfaces: Where public pages live in this repo. Empty for a DB or CMS-backed site — record the CMS above and read the sitemap instead.
_comment_priority_pages: The URLs whose accuracy and reachability matter most. Sampling and claim re-verification key off this list.
_comment_crawl_hubs: Pages Google crawls most often, from batch_url_inspection last_crawled (references/gsc.md §7a). Every new page takes ≥1 inbound link from here. Re-derive every few months.

authority._comment: kd_ceiling is the playable difficulty bucket, derived from GSC page-1 positions, NOT from dr. KD scales are vendor-specific — a bucket from one vendor is meaningless against another, so always store kd_source.
authority._note: Sajten lanserades 2026-10-27; ingen ranking ännu, så nybörjarläget easy gäller.

budget._comment: Unattended runs stay under per_run_usd. Cost never overrides a quality gate — if a decision needs a number, buy it or say you couldn't and why.

select._comment: Below this rubric score (of a possible 20) the best unblocked candidate loses to measure-only. See references/select.md §7.

paths._comment: Only `roadmap` is genuinely relocatable (it predates .seo/ and may live in docs/). Every other entry records where the default already is — the references address those files by their literal .seo/ path, so moving one here does not move it.

logs._comment: null means AI-crawler evidence runs on Search Console alone. Any report must say so.

cache._comment: Read dates for metered slices. Nothing under 30 days old gets re-queried unless the user asks to re-research. The live SERP read is never cached.

sampling._comment: How hard to measure an attribute by priority tier: prompt variants × platforms × repeats.

radar._comment: Demand radar seeds: 5-15 topic phrases in the audience's own words (not product names) and the communities where the ideal customer talks. cadence_days governs the paid tier (news, trends, video); the free tier runs daily.
seeds: how to make AI writing sound human

speed._comment: Lighthouse/PageSpeed on the top pages weekly. psi_api_key_env names the env var holding a PageSpeed Insights key; when absent the skill tries on_page_lighthouse, then a local lighthouse CLI, then records unchecked.

cadence._comment: Freshness windows in hours; a panel younger than its window is read from cache. See measure.md section 0. Weekly (168) and monthly (720) panels: competitor delta, SERP features, backlinks new/lost, link opportunities, seasonality, on-site search.

git._comment: How a run ends. none: show the diff. commit: commit code + .seo/ on the current branch, never push. pr: commit, push, open a PR against main with the run record as body, never merge. Use pr for the worktree loop (fresh worktree -> /seo -> PR -> merge -> repeat).

_comment_competitors: sitemap_url enables the weekly competitor delta panel (measure.md 6d): health_diff.py fingerprints it into .seo/competitors/<domain>/ and competitor_diff.py reports new pages, retitles and keyword gains. null skips the sitemap half; the ranked-keyword half still runs when DataForSEO is connected.

repo._comment: Product-change panel (measure.md 4b). scripts/repo_changes.py lists commits since the last run that touch these globs; a shipped feature, a price change or a removed route is the freshest demand signal the site has. Fill with this repo's real paths.

serp._comment: SERP-feature panel (measure.md 3d). Weekly serp_organic_live_advanced on the top N queries by clicks; serp_features.py records which features appeared and whether the AI Overview cites us.

distribute._comment: The distribute lane. A create-* row younger than window_days with no distribute row is a candidate. social_skill names an installed social-media posting skill, if any (one that drafts and schedules posts to the product's own channels after the user approves); null means the lane writes a social brief instead.

_comment_tools_detected: Filled every run by the detection table in references/setup.md. true means the capability answered a real call. Drives the connections report; tools_declined silences an entry.
_gsc_status: Verifierad 2026-11-02 via DNS-TXT (Porkbun) med tjänstekontot; sitemap inskickad. Den äldre TXT-posten T5sAY46… finns kvar och hör till ett annat konto.
